investigation_question: As of 25 January 2027, how exposed are Midgard and Tolan to the end of the Orvan corridor agreement? Give a low and high range for wheat and maize imports.

evidence_references.title: Corridor Agreement expires with no renewal
evidence_references.summary: Official notification confirming the one-year grain arrangement expired without renewal.
